lines.text: The Holy Spirit tells the Antioch church to set apart Barnabas and Saul, and after fasting and prayer they lay hands on them.
Sent by the Holy Spirit, Barnabas and Saul sail from Seleucia to Crete and preach in the synagogues at Salamis.
At Paphos they find the sorcerer Bar-Jesus, an attendant of the proconsul Sergius Paulus, who wants to hear God's word.
Elymas tries to turn the proconsul from the faith, so Paul says the Lord's hand will make him blind forever.
Mist and darkness fall on Elymas, and the proconsul believes, astonished at the teaching about the Lord.
